gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-fs-supreme: Wobbly and wide-eyed, Jelly Crazies lets its bowls nearly seal shut, while Supreme keeps its letters held open and crisp beneath it. Make the heading small and the fun fades.
gen-dafont-joystix-general-sans: General Sans runs a steady pen pressure with a tall x-height and smooth bends, while Joystix stays chunky, arcade-bold and widely tracked above it. Joystix grabs attention; General Sans keeps going.
gen-dafont-nasalization-satoshi: Satoshi has a soaring x-height and a wide-open e that never looks squeezed, so its text stays friendly. And Nasalization floats its letters apart above it, with short ascenders and calipers-style c.
gen-dafont-nordic-archivo: Spacing like brush dabs placed far apart gives Nordic its ancient weight, every stroke cut to one width, with Archivo's outward-opening curves below it. Nordic makes the statement; Archivo carries the detail.
gen-dafont-origami-fs-epilogue: Brush-sign swagger in a single constant stroke: Origami has a lowercase mass like poured lead, while Epilogue goes curvy and wire-thin beneath. Origami earns its keep big and brief.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-fs-public-sans: Outrun Future keeps a wide distance between letters and follows a constant-width outline, with no swelling mid-curve anywhere. And Public Sans adds a hefty lowercase with broad open counters underneath it.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-fs-supreme: Heavy and bold, Plakkaat bends its lines like straw and sweeps terminals nearly back to the stem. Supreme runs a thick, crisp band of text that stays open, so a full page of it still breathes.
gen-dafont-quantum-general-sans: General Sans reads clean, with an x-height that fills the line. Over a full page its steady pen pressure and smooth bends keep going, while Quantum's loose, tech-flavored letterfit stays up in the heading.
gen-dafont-stencilia-fs-asap: Asap has open-arc c forms and a body height that nearly matches its capitals, so it reads clearly. Stencilia adds structural, striking gaps at its curve terminals above it.
gen-dafont-alien-encounters-switzer: Switzer brings tubular, wire-like letterforms, tall waist line and c tips that never creep toward touching, a Swiss approachable feel. Switzer against Alien Encounters' big, open gaps is the strongest quality: bent tubing under otherworldly spacing.
